scenes.title: ETH Zürich Darkened Sleep Lab & Infrared Eye Tracker
scenes.setting: Darkened ETH Zürich sleep laboratory room cutaway with acoustic testing speaker and synchronized EEG/pupil telemetry bench
scenes.when: 2025, first 4 hours of overnight sleep study
scenes.era: 2025, Neural Control of Movement Lab, ETH Zürich, Zurich, Switzerland
scenes.recognition_hook: An unconscious matte-white miniature sleeper lies beneath a transparent right-eye patch wearing lightweight infrared pupillometry goggles while an infrared lens films live pupil pulses next to stacked EEG Fpz/Cz waveforms.

positions.where: Left-center laboratory bed beneath heavy navy acoustic blackout blanket
positions.facing: Supine facing upward under compact infrared eye-tracking headframe

positions.who: Bedside researcher monitor & acoustic speaker operator
positions.where: Right-rear polysomnography desk behind acoustic baffle screen
positions.facing: Angled left toward Fpz/Cz EEG traces and pupil dilation monitor

props.name: Infrared pupillometry goggles & transparent PRO Optha eye bandage
props.period_detail: Matte dark anodized sensor frame fitted over right eye in pitch-dark room with zero visible glare
props.physical_behavior: Fixed infrared diode illuminates cornea without visible light while high-speed 50 Hz sensor tracks iris-pupil ratio

props.name: Polysomnography headcap & 45 dB pink-noise speaker
props.period_detail: Compact medical EEG scalp leads (Fpz, Cz, O1, O2) wired to bedside amplifier beside small calibrated speaker
props.physical_behavior: Broadcasts 10 x 50 ms soft acoustic clicks at 1 Hz during Stage N2 while logging real-time spindle/K-complex voltage

actions.verb_sequence: protects right ocular surface under transparent PRO Optha S shield -> aligns 50 Hz infrared tracker in pitch darkness -> delivers 45 dB acoustic bursts during N2
remains continuously asleep across Stage N1, N2, N3, and REM while eye-tracker records live autonomic pupil oscillations

reactions.reaction: constricts -11.51% prior to sleep spindles, dilates +13.49% after K-complexes, and surges +35.37% after micro-arousals without conscious waking

key_visual.description: Overhead diagonal 3D diorama of the ETH Zürich sleep room slicing from campus roof down to the sleeping figure's infrared-lit right pupil pulsing in real time as 45 dB sound waves ripple across the pillow.
must_show: infrared eye-tracker sensor over protected right eye
Fpz and Cz sleep EEG monitors beside the pillow
soft acoustic speaker emitting subtle 45 dB sound ripples

scenes.wardrobe: Soft charcoal ribbed laboratory sleep sweater on participant; crisp white lab coat on matte-white technician
scenes.lighting: Deep cool obsidian #080C16 midnight ambient room shadows contrasted with warm tungsten EEG console glow and subtle cyan neuro-signal accent

spatial_contrast_spec.landmark_or_object_a: Constricted baseline pupil window (-25.21% vs N2): sensory gate accepts +5.53 uV^2 acoustic spindle boost
spatial_contrast_spec.landmark_or_object_b: Dilated baseline pupil window (+18.54% vs N2): heightened brainstem arousal blocks spindle boost (+0.08 uV^2)
spatial_contrast_spec.cut_a_landmark_drone: 120ft aerial sweep over ETH Zürich Neo-Renaissance Hauptgebäude limestone cupola descending into darkened sleep lab
spatial_contrast_spec.cut_b_topdown_3d_arrow: Non-spatial prop-and-brain contrast comparing constricted quiet eye against dilated micro-arousal pupil state
